PLT AI API: Register a mobile installation

Binds the installation to a verified Keycloak session.
The verified auth_time starts the idle clock. A newer auth_time resets it even when sid is unchanged.
Registering a new installation with an old auth_time does not restart the clock.
After reauthentication, older tokens for that session cannot resume sync.
A revoked installation cannot be reactivated. An active installation can be rebound to a new verified Keycloak session.

Eski auth_time ile yeni kurulum kaydı açmak süreyi baştan başlatmaz.
Yeniden girişten sonra eski belirteçler bu oturumda eşitlemeye devam edemez.
